caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped box with a lid, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The body and lid of the box are decorated with elaborate geometric and floral patterns. The side of the box features vertical stripes in alternating colors of red, orange, yellow, and purple, interspersed with black lines and filled with small symmetric flower and dot motifs in yellow, green, blue, and black. The periphery of the lid mirrors these patterns, including yellow flowers and geometric shapes, while the top of the lid features a central rectangular section adorned with green, gold, orange, and red patterns mixing diagonal lines, diamond shapes, and small floral shapes, with additional yellow and black flower motifs at the corners. The edges of the box and lid are rimmed with a muted bluish-brown line. The composition is simple, with the box occupying the majority of the image, placed against an unadorned, neutral background.
title: Pa. German's Bride's Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
